BQTnQBagAh8S.text: Explanation: The Horse Laugh fallacy is committed when someone laughs at an argument in a way that implies it is ridiculous, but the argument has not been addressed

KNtDBCkpzsZR.text: A tu quoque response, on the other hand, is when someone challenges an argument by accusing the argument's maker of hypocrisy, but in this case, the sarcastic statement implies that the argument itself is ridiculous, which aligns more with the horse laugh fallacy
